mapper.select: select id ,title ,memo ,to_char(to_timestamp(start_date||start_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as start ,to_char(to_timestamp(end_date||end_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as end ,all_day ,border_color ,background_color ,text_color ,created_at ,updated_at from tb_calendar_events where 1=1
mapper.insert:
select coalesce(max(id), 0) + 1 as id from tb_calendar_events
insert into tb_calendar_events ( id, title, memo, start_date, end_date, start_time, end_time, all_day, border_color, background_color, text_color, created_at ) values( cast(#{id} as integer), #{title}, #{memo}, replace(#{start_date}, '-', ''), replace(#{end_date}, '-', ''), replace(#{start_time}, ':', ''), replace(#{end_time}, ':', ''), #{all_day}, #{border_color}, #{background_color}, #{text_color}, now() )
mapper.delete: delete from tb_calendar_events where id = cast(#{id} as integer)
